product_family: Generative AI platform for clinical conversations and documentation automation. Primary product is Abridge (clinician-facing documentation assistant), with specialized products for nurses, revenue cycle management, and clinical decision support. Enterprise-grade, serving 300+ health systems.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 1 - Security and confidentiality controls validated by independent third-party auditor

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Abridge's products are covered by a SOC 2 Type 2 report, validated by an independent third-party auditor for security and confidentiality

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Abridge's enterprise-grade technology is 100% HIPAA-compliant, and uses industry-best practices to protect patient information. All data is encrypted in-transit and at rest with 256-bit encryption

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA - California Consumer Privacy Act compliance for data protection

certifications.name: TX-RAMP

certifications.name: WCAG 2.2 AA

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on trust center or compliance documentation

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No GDPR-specific compliance guarantees; data residency is US-only ('your personal information will be processed within the US and countries where our service providers are located'). No mention of EU data centers or GDPR adequacy mechanisms.

certifications.name: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement
certifications.proof_quote: Business Associate Agreement available at https://www.abridge.com/terms/business-associate-agreement with full compliance to 45 C.F.R. Part 164 (HIPAA Security Rule)

privacy.ai_training_note: Abridge explicitly does NOT train on customer clinical data. AI training uses only de-identified data: 'Any research and development is performed on de-identified health data or external data sets that are acquired with patient consent.' Speech recognition models trained on 30+ languages using de-identified medical conversations with full patient consent. Customer clinical data remains secure and private, never used for model training.

security.name: Data Centers
security.value: HIPAA-compliant, secure US-based data centers with encryption

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Strict internal access-control policies to prevent privacy violations; principle of least privilege

security.name: Third-Party Auditing
security.value: SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits by independent third-party auditors

security.name: Subcontractor Oversight
security.value: Requires 'reasonable assurances' from agents and subcontractors regarding PHI protection

products.name: Abridge (Clinician Platform)
products.data_scope: Real-time clinical conversations, patient audio recordings, medical notes. Processes Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA BAA.
products.notes: Primary product serving 300+ health systems. Supports 40+ specialties, 9,400+ clinicians, 500K+ patients across 60+ centers in 28 languages. Reduces cognitive load by 78%, note-writing effort by 83%.

products.name: Abridge for Nurses
products.data_scope: Nursing shift notes, patient interactions, bedside documentation
products.notes: Launched 2025. TIME Magazine Best Inventions 2025. Supports nursing documentation at point of care.

products.name: Clinical Decision Support (CDS)
products.data_scope: Clinical reference data, evidence-based recommendations integrated with conversations
products.notes: Brings NEJM and JAMA evidence into clinical conversations. Supports care gap identification.

products.name: Revenue Cycle Management
products.data_scope: Coded encounter data, billing documentation derived from conversations
products.notes: Automates coding specificity and RCM workflows. Supports wRVU optimization.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS (per-clinician or per-encounter licensing, custom pricing). No public pricing available.
compare.data_residency: US-only; no EU/GDPR-specific data residency options

flags: ISO 27001 not mentioned despite enterprise healthcare focus: notable gap for a company serving 300+ health systems at enterprise scale
No GDPR compliance or EU data residency options; US-only data storage limits European customer adoption
While AI training uses de-identified data, the BAA allows Abridge to use PHI for 'proper management and administration of Business Associate'; verify that this does not include undisclosed uses
